description: The taxable benefit on a company car from its list price and CO2 figure, and the income tax it adds a year and a month. Use for 'how much tax on an electric company car worth £45k'.

capitalContribution.description: The employee's own contribution towards the car, up to £5,000. Defaults to 0.

co2.description: Official CO2 in g/km. 0 for fully electric.

diesel.description: A diesel that isn't RDE2 compliant. Defaults to false.

electricRangeMiles.description: Electric-only range in miles, for a hybrid of 1 to 50 g/km.

income.description: The employee's income before tax, without the car, in pounds a year.

p11dValue.description: The car's list price with options (P11D value).

name: calculate_company_car_tax
title: Company car tax
